entities.name: Cosiman Reefs
entities.description: Set of seven coral reefs northeast of Etlan Shiis, home to the Coral Caves and an independent merfolk tribe, each guarded by Metathran.

entities.name: Etlan Shiis
entities.description: Place northeast of which the reefs lie.

entities.name: Voda Sea
entities.description: Sea in whose northern part the reefs likely lie.

entities.name: Vodalia
entities.description: Merfolk domain from which the reefs' tribe appears independent.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: Blue-skinned water-breathing humanoids Urza created from Toraix's genetic material, guarding the reefs.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Created the Metathran from Toraix's genetic material and swore to send them to Cosiman reefs.

entities.name: Toraix
entities.description: Would-be last aquatic Protector dragon of Cosiman, whose genetic material Urza used.

entities.name: Maraavis
entities.description: Toraix's mother, to whom Urza made a promise.

events.summary: Urza used Toraix's genetic material to create the Metathran and promised Maraavis to send them to the reefs after repelling the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Urza swore to send the Metahtran to Cosiman reefs

relations.note: Urza made them from Toraix's genetic material.
relations.quote: he used the genetic material of Toraix
